subject: Observability conformance sprint outcomes & next steps
messages:
From: Erin Park <erin.park@datadog.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed conformance sprint: Observability telemetry matrix

Hi Markus (and team),

Thanks for the quick intro last week — Datadog and Grafana are keen to move from exploratory integration to a short conformance sprint to validate telemetry coverage and unblock the marketplace bundles.

Goal: produce a clear compatibility matrix (metrics/traces/logs/OTLP semantics + tagging conventions) and a small runbook that we can reference in partner docs and the marketplace listing. Anticipated output: a single matrix file and a sprint retrospective with owners.

As a starting point I attached a draft matrix (obs_conformance_matrix_v1.xlsx) and propose a 90-minute working session next Thursday (Jun 17) to:
- align on schema mapping (service.name / host / resource attributes)
- surface any ingestion limits/transform constraints on both sides
- define 3 quick validation tests we can run in staging

Can you confirm who from Redwood should join (suggested: infra + integrations + a security reviewer)? Also please share any existing telemetry guides you want us to use as pre-read.

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/987654321
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-observability-conformance
HubSpot deal id: 12345

Thanks,
Erin Park
Strategic Partnerships
Datadog

Attachment: obs_conformance_matrix_v1.xlsx

Subject: Re: Proposed conformance sprint: Observability telemetry matrix

Thanks Erin — this looks useful and the scope is right. Redwood can commit a 90-minute working session. Proposed attendees from our side:
- Markus Klein (Partner Lead)
- Laura Bennett (Integration PM)
- Vanessa Ortiz (Alliances)
- Ben Carter (Platform Security / Ingestion constraints)

Pre-reads well share before the meeting:
- current telemetry ingestion limits and attribute whitelist (internal doc)
- our exporter/OTLP mapping guide (short PDF)

Suggested agenda for the 90-minute session:
1) 10m quick intros & sprint objectives
2) 25m schema mapping (metrics/traces/attributes)
3) 20m ingestion constraints & transformations (Ben to lead)
4) 20m validation tests and staging plan
5) 15m owners, timeline, and next steps

Can Datadog/Grafana confirm who will present the matrix rows and whether Grafana will join live? Also, do you have a canonical telemetry example (span/metric sample) we should align on ahead of time?

Ill upload our pre-reads to the Drive link and share access by EOD Monday.

—Markus
Markus Klein

Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Park <erin.park@datadog.com>, Samir Khan <samir.khan@grafana.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Observability conformance sprint — retrospective and owners

Folks,

Thanks for a productive session this morning. Attached are the sprint retrospective notes and the action-item list (Sprint_Retrospective_Notes.pdf). Summary highlights and owners below:

Decisions made:
- Agreed canonical mapping for service.name, service.version and resource attributes (Laura to publish mapping doc). Owner: laura_bennett — due 2027-06-21
- Agreed on three staging validation tests: (1) metric tagging fidelity, (2) span attribute propagation, (3) log parser roundtrip. Owner: vanessa_ortiz + Grafana (Samir) — test plan due 2027-06-24
- Determined ingestion limit workarounds for high-cardinality metrics (Ben to propose rate-limiting guardrails). Owner: ben_carter — due 2027-06-23

Action items (short):
- Laura: publish canonical mapping + upload to Drive (link above) — 2027-06-21
- Vanessa & Samir: produce test plan and sample data — 2027-06-24
- Ben: produce ingestion constraints doc and suggested mitigations — 2027-06-23
- Markus: coordinate follow-up runbook and marketplace docs draft — 2027-06-28

Next meeting: quick check-in (30m) on 2027-06-25 to review sample test results. Erin, Samir — please confirm availability.

Forwarded meeting minutes are attached. If there are any omissions or corrections to the owners above, reply-all and I'll update the doc.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Sprint_Retrospective_Notes.pdf
